description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayEndpointStore component in a Swift project, including tests for token resolution, mode resolution, host resolution, URL normalization, and configuration building related to gateway endpoints.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointStoreTests
classes.description: A collection of unit tests for GatewayEndpointStore functionality, including token resolution, mode configuration, host resolution, URL formatting, and normalization.

methods.name: makeLaunchAgentSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a mock LaunchAgentPlistSnapshot with specified environment variables and credentials.

methods.name: makeDefaults
methods.description: Creates a new distinct UserDefaults instance for testing purposes.

methods.name: resolve gateway token prefers env and falls back to launchd
methods.description: Tests that gateway token resolution prefers environment variables and falls back to launchd snapshot.

methods.name: resolve gateway token ignores launchd in remote mode
methods.description: Ensures that in remote mode, the launchd snapshot is ignored for token resolution.

methods.name: resolveGatewayTokenUsesRemoteConfigToken
methods.description: Tests resolution of remote config token overrides other sources.

methods.name: resolveGatewayPasswordFallsBackToLaunchd
methods.description: Tests that password resolution prefers environment variables and falls back to launchd snapshot.

methods.name: connection mode resolver prefers config mode over defaults
methods.description: Verifies that the connection mode resolver uses the mode specified in the config over default values.

methods.name: connection mode resolver trims config mode
methods.description: Ensures whitespace in config mode strings is trimmed during resolution.

methods.name: connection mode resolver falls back to defaults when missing config
methods.description: Checks that default mode is used if no config mode is specified.

methods.name: connection mode resolver falls back to defaults on unknown config
methods.description: Ensures fallback to default mode when config has unrecognized value.

methods.name: connection mode resolver prefers remote URL when mode missing
methods.description: Prioritizes remote URL detection over mode setting.

methods.name: resolve local gateway host uses loopback for auto even with tailnet
methods.description: Verifies loopback address is used when bind mode is auto and tailnet IP is provided.

methods.name: resolve local gateway host uses loopback for auto without tailnet
methods.description: Verifies loopback address is used when bind mode is auto and no tailnet IP.

methods.name: resolve local gateway host prefers tailnet for tailnet mode
methods.description: Uses tailnet IP as host when mode is tailnet and IP is available.

methods.name: resolve local gateway host falls back to loopback for tailnet mode
methods.description: Uses loopback address if tailnet mode is set but no tailnet IP is available.

methods.name: resolve local gateway host uses custom bind host
methods.description: Uses user-specified custom bind host when mode is custom.

methods.name: local config uses local gateway auth and host resolution
methods.description: Tests that local configuration correctly resolves URL, token, and password.

methods.name: dashboard URL uses local base path in local mode
methods.description: Verifies that dashboard URL correctly appends local base path in local mode.

methods.name: dashboard URL skips local base path in remote mode
methods.description: Ensures dashboard URL does not append local base path in remote mode.

methods.name: dashboard URL prefers path from config URL
methods.description: Verifies that the URL fragment in config URL is used in dashboard URL.

methods.name: dashboard URL uses fragment token and omits password
methods.description: Ensures token is included in URL fragment and password is omitted.

methods.name: normalize gateway url adds default port for loopback ws
methods.description: Tests that loopback ws URL is normalized with default port 18789.

methods.name: normalize gateway url rejects non loopback ws
methods.description: Verifies normalization rejects non-loopback ws URLs.

methods.name: normalize gateway url rejects prefix bypass loopback host
methods.description: Ensures URLs with spoofed loopback hosts are rejected.
